basic_info.description: A Blank Canvas in San Francisco’s Hottest Market!  This charming corner-lot home offers unlimited potential in one of the city’s most sought-after neighborhoods. Flooded with natural light from stunning bay windows, the living room boasts captivating ocean views that create an inviting and serene atmosphere.  With a permitted third bedroom and full bathroom downstairs, complete with a wet bar and separate entrance, the home is primed for rental income or multigenerational living.  Go outside to a private backyard featuring a covered patio and a grassy lawn ideal for pets or play. Whether you're looking to invest, expand, or personalize, this property is a rare opportunity to create your dream space in San Francisco.  Don't miss your chance to own a versatile home in a premier location!
